items.sentence: The MHRA has approved icotrokinra (Icotyde), a once-daily tablet, for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in people aged 12 and over.

items.sentence: The MHRA approved icotrokinra hydrochloride (Icotyde) for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in October 2026.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The approval covers adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older who weigh at least 40 kg.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: It applies to people who are candidates for systemic therapy.

items.sentence: The MHRA says it has approved icotrokinra hydrochloride (Icotyde) for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older who weigh at least 40 kg.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The medicine is a tablet taken once a day, and the marketing authorisation was granted to Janssen-Cilag Limited.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The approval applies to people who are candidates for systemic therapy, which means treatment that acts throughout the body rather than on the skin alone.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says its decision rested on four phase 3 trials with about 2,500 participants, 72 of them adolescents aged 12 to under 18 who weighed at least 40 kg.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: In all four trials, icotrokinra showed benefit over placebo at week 16.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.
